units.zh: 徐用儀，字筱雲，浙江海鹽人。
units.en: Xu Yongyi, whose courtesy name was Xiaoyun, came from Haiyan in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Xu Yongyi, courtesy name Xiaoyun, was a native of Haiyan in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 由副貢生入貲為主事，官刑部。
units.en: Having bought office as a deputy tribute graduate, he entered service as a principal secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.
units.literal: Through the office purchased by deputy tribute graduates he became a principal secretary and served in the Ministry of Punishments.

units.zh: 咸豐九年，舉順天鄉試．同治初，充軍機章京，兼直總理各國事務衙門。
units.en: In Xianfeng 9 he passed the Shuntian provincial examination; early in Tongzhi he became a Grand Council clerk and also served at the Zongli Yamen.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he passed the provincial examination in Shuntian; at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he served as a Grand Council clerk and concurrently attended the Zongli Yamen.

units.zh: 累遷鴻臚寺少卿，以憂歸。
units.en: He rose step by step to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, then left office to mourn a parent.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and returned home on bereavement leave.

units.zh: 光緒三年，起太僕寺少卿，遷大理寺卿，直軍機如故。
units.en: In Guangxu 3 he was recalled as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, then made President of the Court of Judicial Review while still attending the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the third year of Guangxu he was recalled as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and transferred to President of the Court of Judicial Review, continuing to attend the Grand Council as before.

units.zh: 擢工部侍郎，始罷直。
units.en: Promoted to Vice Minister of Works, he at last gave up his regular seat on the Council.
units.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Works and only then ceased regular attendance at the Council.

units.zh: 旋充總理衙門大臣，歷兵部、吏部侍郎，授軍機大臣。
units.en: He soon became a Zongli Yamen minister, served as vice minister of War and of Personnel in turn, and was appointed to the Grand Council.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he served as a Zongli Yamen minister, passed through the vice ministries of War and Personnel, and was appointed a Grand Council minister.

units.zh: 二十年，加太子少保。
units.en: In year 20 of the reign he received the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 日朝搆为，舉朝爭議和戰，樞臣孫毓汶被劾罷，翁同龢繼入，主戰益力。
units.en: When Japan provoked conflict, the court split over peace and war; Grand Councillor Sun Yuwen was impeached out of office, and Weng Tonghe took his place and argued for war even harder.
units.literal: Japan stirred up trouble; the whole court debated peace and war; Grand Councillor Sun Yuwen was impeached and dismissed; Weng Tonghe succeeded him and pressed for war all the more.

units.zh: 用儀論事與同龢忤，遂出樞廷，並解總署事。
units.en: Because Yongyi's policy views clashed with Weng Tonghe's, he was expelled from the Grand Council and stripped of his Yamen post as well.
units.literal: Yongyi's views on affairs clashed with Tonghe's, and he was therefore removed from the Council and also relieved of his Zongli Yamen duties.

units.zh: 二十四年，皇太后再訓政，復直總署，迺密薦太常寺卿袁昶。
units.en: In Guangxu 24, after the Empress Dowager resumed rule, he returned to the Yamen and privately recommended Yuan Chang of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Empress Dowager resumed personal rule; he again attended the Yamen and thereupon secretly recommended Yuan Chang, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 會許景澄奉使還，被命同入署。
units.en: About then Xu Jingcheng came back from abroad and was ordered to join the Yamen with him.
units.literal: At that time Xu Jingcheng returned from a diplomatic mission and was ordered to enter the Yamen together with him.

units.zh: 二十六年，拳禍起。
units.en: In Guangxu 26 the Boxer disaster broke out.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer calamity arose.

units.zh: 先是上以行新政為中外所推，而儲嗣久虛。
units.en: The emperor had lately won praise at home and abroad for reform, but the succession had stood vacant for years.
units.literal: Earlier the Emperor had been praised at home and abroad for carrying out new policies, yet the heir had long remained unsettled.

units.zh: 載漪既用事，陰謀廢立，慮外人為梗，聞拳民有神勇，仇西教，欲倚以集事，召入京，遂縱恣不可制。
units.en: Once Zaiyi was in charge he plotted deposition and enthronement in secret, fearing foreign interference; told the Boxers were supernaturally brave and hated Christianity, he meant to use them to carry out his plan, called them to Beijing, and they soon could not be restrained.
units.literal: Once Zaiyi held power he plotted in secret to depose and enthrone, fearing foreigners would obstruct him; hearing that Boxers had divine valor and hated Western religion, he wished to rely on them to accomplish his design, summoned them to the capital, and they then ran riot beyond control.

units.zh: 用儀請嚴禁遏，不聽。
units.en: Yongyi urged stern prohibition and suppression, but no one listened.
units.literal: Yongyi requested strict prohibition and suppression, but was not heeded.

units.zh: 俄戕德使克林德，用儀駭曰：「禍始此矣！」
units.en: Soon the German minister von Ketteler was murdered; Yongyi cried in alarm, "The calamity starts here!"
units.literal: Before long the German minister Klemens von Ketteler was killed; Yongyi said in alarm: "Disaster begins here!"

units.zh: 言於慶親王奕劻，厚歛之。
units.en: He told Prince Qing Yikuang, who raised a heavy sum of money.
units.literal: He spoke to Prince Qing Yikuang, who collected funds in large amounts.

units.zh: 各國兵艦至津沽，詔廷臣集議和戰。
units.en: Foreign warships reached Taku; the throne ordered ministers to meet and debate war or peace.
units.literal: Warships of the various powers reached Taku; an edict ordered court ministers to assemble and debate peace and war.

units.zh: 用儀、景澄、昶及尚書立山、內閣學士聯元並言：「奸民不可縱，外为不可啟。」
units.en: Yongyi, Jingcheng, Chang, Minister Li Shan, and Hanlin Bachelor Lian Yuan jointly declared, "Riotous mobs must not be indulged, and foreign conflict must not be started."
units.literal: Yongyi, Jingcheng, Chang, and Minister Li Shan and Hanlin Bachelor Lian Yuan all said together: "Wicked commoners must not be indulged; foreign trouble must not be provoked."

units.zh: 而載漪等主戰甚力，在廷大臣率依違不決。
units.en: But Zaiyi and his party argued fiercely for war, and most ministers at court vacillated without a decision.
units.literal: Yet Zaiyi and others pressed for war with great force, and ministers at court mostly wavered and could not decide.

units.zh: 用儀以太后命詣使館議緩兵，當事者益目為奸邪。
units.en: Sent by the Empress Dowager to the legations to negotiate a pause in fighting, Yongyi was seen by the war party as all the more treacherous.
units.literal: Yongyi, on the Empress Dowager's order, went to the legations to negotiate a truce; those in charge regarded him all the more as a traitor.

units.zh: 景澄、昶先被害，用儀知不免，意氣自如。
units.en: Jingcheng and Chang were executed first; Yongyi knew his end was near yet kept his bearing calm.
units.literal: Jingcheng and Chang were killed first; Yongyi knew he could not escape yet remained composed in spirit.

units.zh: 七月既望，遽發拳匪捕之於家，擁至莊王邸。
units.en: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month Boxers suddenly arrested him at home and marched him to Prince Zhuang's residence.
units.literal: On the full moon of the seventh month Boxers suddenly seized him at his home and escorted him to Prince Zhuang's mansion.

units.zh: 用儀不置辯，第曰：「天降奇禍，死固分耳！」
units.en: Yongyi made no defense and only said, "Heaven has sent this extraordinary disaster; to die is only my due!"
units.literal: Yongyi offered no defense and only said: "Heaven sends this strange calamity; death is my allotted share!"

units.zh: 遂與立山、聯元同棄市。
units.en: He was then publicly executed together with Li Shan and Lian Yuan.
units.literal: He was then executed in the marketplace together with Li Shan and Lian Yuan.

units.zh: 越三日，聯軍入京，而兩宮西狩。
units.en: Three days later the allied forces entered Beijing as the two courts fled west.
units.literal: Three days later the allied armies entered the capital while the two sovereigns fled west.

units.zh: 十二月，詔湔雪，復故官。
units.en: In the twelfth month an edict rehabilitated them and restored their former ranks.
units.literal: In the twelfth month an edict cleared their names and restored their former offices.

units.zh: 宣統元年，追諡忠愍。
units.en: In Xuantong 1 he received the posthumous title Zhongmin, Loyal and Suffering.
units.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he was posthumously given the title Zhongmin.

units.zh: 浙人祠之西湖，與景澄、昶並稱「三忠」。
units.en: Zhejiang gentry built him a shrine at West Lake; with Jingcheng and Chang he was known as one of the "Three Loyal Ones."
units.literal: Men of Zhejiang enshrined him at West Lake; together with Jingcheng and Chang they were called the "Three Loyal Ones."

units.zh: 許景澄，字竹篔，嘉興人。
units.en: Xu Jingcheng, whose courtesy name was Zhuyun, came from Jiaxing.
units.literal: Xu Jingcheng, courtesy name Zhuyun, was a native of Jiaxing.

units.zh: 同治七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: In Tongzhi 7 he became a metropolitan graduate, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was made an editor.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed an editor.

units.zh: 明習時事，大學士文祥以使才薦。
units.en: Well versed in current affairs, he was recommended by Grand Secretary Wenxiang for talent in foreign service.
units.literal: He was well versed in current affairs; Grand Secretary Wenxiang recommended him for diplomatic talent.

units.zh: 光緒六年，詔使日本，遭父憂，未行。
units.en: In Guangxu 6 he was ordered envoy to Japan, but his father died and he never went.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he was ordered to serve as envoy to Japan but met his father's death and did not go.

units.zh: 服闋，補侍講。
units.en: After mourning he was appointed supervising reader.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was made a supervising reader.

units.zh: 法越之役，條上籌備事宜，上褒納。
units.en: During the Sino-French War he laid out preparedness measures in a memorial, which the throne praised and adopted.
units.literal: During the Sino-French War he submitted in detail plans for preparedness; the Emperor praised and accepted them.

units.zh: 十年，出使法德意和奧五國大臣，兼攝比國使務。
units.en: In year 10 he became minister to France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, and Austria, and concurrently to Belgium.
units.literal: In the tenth year he served as minister to France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, and Austria, and concurrently handled Belgian affairs.

units.zh: 時海軍初創，從德國購造鐵艦，未就。
units.en: The navy had just been created; ironclads ordered from Germany were still unfinished.
units.literal: At that time the navy was newly founded; ironclads were being purchased from Germany but were not yet completed.

units.zh: 景澄躬歷船廠，鉤稽輯上外國師船表。
units.en: Jingcheng inspected the yards himself, verified the figures, and submitted a register of foreign warships and instructors.
units.literal: Jingcheng personally visited the shipyards, investigated and compiled, and submitted a table of foreign warships and instructors.

units.zh: 又言海軍宜定屯埠膠州灣，設鐵甲尓船大沽口。
units.en: He also urged fixing the fleet's base at Jiaozhou Bay and posting ironclads at Dagu.
units.literal: He also said the navy ought to fix its base at Jiaozhou Bay and station ironclads at the Dagu mouth.

units.zh: 轉侍讀，母憂歸。
units.en: Made reader-in-waiting, he then left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: He was transferred to reader-in-waiting and returned home on his mother's death.

units.zh: 十六年，充出使俄德奧和四國大臣，累遷至內閣學士。
units.en: In year 16 he became minister to Russia, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands, rising in time to Hanlin bachelor.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he served as minister to Russia, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands, and was promoted in succession to Hanlin bachelor.

units.zh: 先是俄兵游獵，常越界，侵及帕米爾地，景澄爭之，俄援舊議定界起烏什別里山，自此而南屬中國，其西南屬俄。
units.en: Russian troops hunting beyond the border had long encroached on the Pamirs; Jingcheng contested this, while Russia invoked the old treaty line from Mount Wushibieli south to China and southwest to Russia.
units.literal: Earlier Russian soldiers on hunting expeditions often crossed the border and encroached on the Pamirs; Jingcheng disputed this; Russia cited the old agreement that the boundary began at Wushibieli Mountain, from which southward belonged to China and southwestward to Russia.

units.zh: 俄人則欲以薩雷闊勒為界。
units.en: Russia wanted the Sarikol Pass as the border.
units.literal: The Russians wished to take the Sarikol Pass as the boundary.

units.zh: 相持三載，俄始允改議，其帕界未定以前，各不進兵，以保和好。
units.en: After three years Russia agreed to reopen talks; until the Pamir line was settled neither side would move troops, to keep the peace.
units.literal: The dispute lasted three years before Russia agreed to revise the talks; until the Pamir boundary was fixed neither side would advance troops, to preserve amity.

units.zh: 因著帕米爾圖說、西北邊界地名考證，為他日界約備。
units.en: He wrote An Illustrated Account of the Pamirs and Textual Verification of Northwestern Border Place-Names to prepare a future boundary agreement.
units.literal: He therefore wrote An Illustrated Account of the Pamirs and Textual Verification of Northwestern Border Place-Names, as preparation for a future boundary treaty.

units.zh: 擢工部侍郎。
units.en: He was made Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 是時俄、德迫日人還遼東，景澄曰：「俄謀自便，德圖償報，事故從此多矣！」
units.en: When Russia and Germany forced Japan to return Liaodong, Jingcheng warned, "Russia schemes for itself and Germany for compensation—trouble will multiply from this!"
units.literal: At that time Russia and Germany pressed Japan to return Liaodong; Jingcheng said: "Russia plots for its own convenience, Germany seeks repayment; troubles will multiply from this!"

units.zh: 疏請分遣兩使，從之。
units.en: He memorialized to send two separate envoys, and the court agreed.
units.literal: He memorialized requesting two envoys be sent separately, and the request was followed.

units.zh: 二十三年，調充德國使臣。
units.en: In year 23 he was reassigned as minister to Germany.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to serve as minister to Germany.

units.zh: 會俄建西比利亞鐵道，謀自黑龍江達海參崴，朝議拒之，迺更名商辦，許中國投貲五百萬，所謂東清鐵路公司也。
units.en: Russia was building the Siberian line toward Vladivostok from the Amur; after court debate the project was recast as a joint commercial railway with five million taels of Chinese capital—the Chinese Eastern Railway Company.
units.literal: At that time Russia was building the Siberian railway, planning to reach Vladivostok from the Amur; the court debated refusal; it was then renamed a commercial venture, and China was allowed to invest five million taels—the so-called Chinese Eastern Railway Company.

units.zh: 詔景澄綜其事，力阻路悋南溢，稽察運船毋漏稅。
units.en: Ordered to oversee the railway, he fought to keep its rights from spreading south and audited shipping so duties were not evaded.
units.literal: Jingcheng was ordered to oversee the matter, strenuously blocking the line's rights from spilling southward and auditing transport ships so taxes would not be evaded.

units.zh: 已而俄人索租旅順，充頭等公使，會駐俄使臣楊儒定議俄都。
units.en: Soon Russia demanded Port Arthur on lease; as first-class minister he joined envoy Yang Ru in talks at St. Petersburg.
units.literal: Before long the Russians demanded lease of Port Arthur; he served as first-class minister and joined the resident envoy Yang Ru in negotiating at the Russian capital.

units.zh: 事竣，移疾歸，召授總理各國事務大臣兼禮部侍郎。
units.en: When negotiations ended he returned on sick leave, then was recalled as Zongli Yamen minister and Vice Minister of Rites.
units.literal: When the business was finished he resigned on grounds of illness and returned; he was summoned and appointed Zongli Yamen minister and Vice Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 調吏部，充大學堂總教習、管學大臣。
units.en: Transferred to Personnel, he became chief instructor and superintendent of the Imperial University.
units.literal: He was transferred to Personnel and served as chief instructor and superintendent of the Imperial University.

units.zh: 意大利索我三門灣，景澄抗言爭之，事迺寢。
units.en: When Italy demanded Sanmen Bay, Jingcheng argued back until the claim was dropped.
units.literal: Italy demanded our Sanmen Bay; Jingcheng resisted and argued; the matter then lapsed.

units.zh: 未幾，拳禍作，景澄召見時，歷陳兵为不可啟，春秋之義，不殺行人，圍攻使館，實背公法。
units.en: When the Boxer crisis erupted and Jingcheng was summoned, he insisted war must not be started, cited the Spring and Autumn rule against killing envoys, and said besieging legations violated international law.
units.literal: Before long the Boxer calamity broke out; when Jingcheng was summoned for audience he set forth in detail that military trouble must not be started, that the Spring and Autumn principle forbids killing envoys, and that besieging legations truly violated public law.

units.zh: 太后聞之動容，而載漪等斥為邪說。
units.en: The Empress Dowager was visibly moved, but Zaiyi and his party called it pernicious talk.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager was moved on hearing this, but Zaiyi and others denounced it as heterodox doctrine.

units.zh: 聯軍偪近畿，景澄等遂坐主和棄市。
units.en: As the allies neared the capital, Jingcheng and others were executed for advocating peace.
units.literal: When the allied armies pressed close to the capital, Jingcheng and others were executed on the charge of favoring peace.

units.zh: 宣統元年，追諡文肅。
units.en: In Xuantong 1 he received the posthumous title Wensu, Cultured and Stern.
units.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he was posthumously given the title Wensu.

units.zh: 袁昶，字爽秋，桐廬人。
units.en: Yuan Chang, whose courtesy name was Shuangqiu, came from Tonglu.
units.literal: Yuan Chang, courtesy name Shuangqiu, was a native of Tonglu.

units.zh: 從劉熙載讀，博通掌故。
units.en: He studied under Liu Xizai and mastered institutional history.
units.literal: He studied under Liu Xizai and was broadly versed in historical precedent.

units.zh: 光緒二年進士，授戶部主事，充總理各國事務衙門章京。
units.en: In Guangxu 2 he became a metropolitan graduate, entered Revenue as principal secretary, and served as a Yamen clerk.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, and served as a Zongli Yamen clerk.

units.zh: 十八年，以員外郎出任徽寧池太廣道。
units.en: In year 18 he left the capital as intendant of the Huaining-Chizhou-Taiping-Guangde circuit.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, as an assistant department director, he went out to serve as intendant of the Huaining-Chizhou-Taiping-Guangde circuit.

units.zh: 誡僚屬，抑胥吏，多所興革；
units.en: He warned his staff, reined in clerks, and instituted many reforms;
units.literal: He admonished subordinates, restrained clerks, and carried out many reforms;

units.zh: 擴中江書院齋舍，課以實學；
units.en: he enlarged Zhongjiang Academy quarters and taught practical learning;
units.literal: he expanded the dormitories of the Zhongjiang Academy and taught practical learning;

units.zh: 建尊經閣，購書數萬卷；
units.en: he built a Hall for Honoring the Classics and bought tens of thousands of books;
units.literal: he built the Hall for Honoring the Classics and purchased tens of thousands of volumes;

units.zh: 汰常關耗費歲萬八千金，悉還諸公；
units.en: he cut eighteen thousand taels of yearly waste at the regular customs house and returned it to the public purse;
units.literal: he eliminated eighteen thousand taels of yearly waste at the regular customs post and returned it all to the public account;

units.zh: 定專條，納新關穀米出口稅，歲羨數十萬；
units.en: he set special rules for grain export tax at the new customs house, yielding hundreds of thousands in surplus each year;
units.literal: he fixed special regulations, collected export tax on grain at the new customs post, and yearly surplus ran to several hundred thousand;

units.zh: 督修蕪湖西南濱江圩隄，自大關亭至魯港，延袤十二里；
units.en: he oversaw repairs to Wuhu's southwest river embankment from Daguan Pavilion to Lugang, twelve li in length;
units.literal: he supervised repair of the river embankment along the southwest bank at Wuhu, from Daguan Pavilion to Lugang, extending twelve li;

units.zh: 更穿築新縷隄三百七十丈，自是蓄洩有資，田廬完固，民歌誦之。
units.en: he added a new continuous dike three hundred seventy zhang long; flooding could then be controlled, farms and homes were safe, and the people praised him in song.
units.literal: he further dug and built a new continuous embankment three hundred seventy zhang long; thereafter storage and drainage had support, fields and houses were secure, and the people sang his praise.

units.zh: 膠州事起，下詔求言，昶條列時政二萬餘言，以：「德突據膠灣，其禍急而小；
units.en: After the Jiaozhou crisis the throne sought advice; Chang submitted more than twenty thousand characters, arguing, "Germany's seizure of Jiaozhou was urgent but small;
units.literal: When the Jiaozhou affair arose the throne called for memorials; Chang set forth more than twenty thousand characters on current policy, saying: "Germany's sudden seizure of Jiaozhou is a calamity urgent yet small;

units.zh: 俄自西北至東北，與我壤地相錯，蒙喀四十八部將折入異域，其禍紆而大。
units.en: Russia from the northwest to the northeast shares intertwined territory with us; the forty-eight Mongol and Khalkha banners will be folded into foreign lands—the calamity is winding yet great.
units.literal: Russia from the northwest to the northeast shares intertwined territory with us; the forty-eight Mongol and Khalkha banners will be folded into foreign lands—the calamity is winding yet great.

units.zh: 宜及今預練勁旅，痛革吉、奉華靡風習。
units.en: We ought even now to train crack troops beforehand and thoroughly reform the extravagant habits of Jilin and Fengtian.
units.literal: We ought even now to train crack troops beforehand and thoroughly reform the extravagant habits of Jilin and Fengtian.

units.zh: 自頃兵力不能議戰，要不可不議守。
units.en: Lately our military strength cannot sustain debate on war, yet we absolutely cannot fail to debate defense.
units.literal: Lately our military strength cannot sustain debate on war, yet we absolutely cannot fail to debate defense.

units.zh: 我朝八旗初制，文武不分途，京外不分途，人皆兵，官皆將，故人才盛，國勢強。
units.en: Under the original Eight Banner system civil and military, capital and province were one; every man was a soldier and every officer a commander, so talent abounded and the state was strong.
units.literal: Our dynasty's original Eight Banner system made no distinction between civil and military tracks, nor between capital and provinces; every man was a soldier and every official a general; therefore talent flourished and national strength was great.

units.zh: 承平日久，文法繁密，諸臣救過之不暇，於是相率為鄉愿，而舉國之人才靡矣！
units.en: Long peace bred intricate regulations; officials scrambled only to avoid blame, fell into timid conformity, and national talent withered.
units.literal: After long peace the code grew intricate; ministers had no leisure beyond correcting faults; they therefore followed one another in timid conformity, and the nation's talent withered!

units.zh: 金田洪、楊之亂，其始一小民耳，猶窮全國之力僅而克之，況諸國互肆蠶食之心，有不乘吾敝而攻吾之短者哉？
units.en: The Taiping revolt began with ordinary villagers yet nearly exhausted the empire; with many powers eager to devour us, who would not strike when we were weak?
units.literal: The Hong and Yang rebellion of Jintian began with a single commoner, yet the empire's full strength barely overcame it; how much more when many states all harbor designs of nibbling us—will there not be those who seize our weakness and strike our flaws?

units.zh: 夫敵國外患，為殷憂啟聖之資。
units.en: Foreign enemies and external troubles are resources by which deep anxiety awakens sagely rule.
units.literal: Foreign enemies and external troubles are resources by which deep anxiety awakens sagely rule.

units.zh: 苟得其人，毋拘以文法，則理財、練兵、防海、交鄰之策，可次第就理。」
units.en: Given the right men, unbound by red tape, finance, armies, coast defense, and diplomacy could be put in order one by one."
units.literal: If the right men are obtained and not bound by written regulations, then policies for finance, training troops, coastal defense, and foreign relations can be set in order step by step."

units.zh: 上親書其綱要於冊，下中外大臣議行。
units.en: The emperor copied its main points into a booklet and circulated them to ministers at home and abroad for action.
units.literal: The Emperor personally copied its main points into a booklet and sent it down to Chinese and foreign ministers for discussion and implementation.

units.zh: 二十四年，遷陝西按察使，未到官，擢江寧布政使，調直隸。
units.en: In year 24 he was named Shaanxi judicial commissioner, then promoted to Jiangning financial commissioner and moved to Zhili before taking the first post.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to Shaanxi judicial commissioner; before taking office he was promoted to Jiangning financial commissioner and transferred to Zhili.

units.zh: 未幾，內召，以三品京堂在總理衙門行走，授光祿寺卿，轉太常寺卿。
units.en: Soon recalled to Beijing, he served at the Yamen as a third-rank capital official, became Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, then Director of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: Before long he was summoned to the capital; as a third-rank capital official he served at the Zongli Yamen, was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and transferred to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 時財用匱，議整釐稅。
units.en: Finances were depleted and officials debated reorganizing the likin tax.
units.literal: At that time finances were depleted and there was debate on reorganizing the likin tax.

units.zh: 昶極言釐金名病商，實病民，不可議增。
units.en: Chang insisted likin nominally hurt merchants but really hurt the people and must not be raised.
units.literal: Chang strongly argued that likin by name harms merchants but in fact harms the people, and must not be increased.

units.zh: 義和團起山東，屠戮外國教士。
units.en: The Boxer movement rose in Shandong and massacred foreign missionaries.
units.literal: The Boxers arose in Shandong and slaughtered foreign missionaries.

units.zh: 昶與許景澄相善，廷詢時，陳奏皆谒慨，上執景澄手而泣。
units.en: Close to Xu Jingcheng, Chang spoke as bluntly as he at court audiences; the emperor took Jingcheng's hand and wept.
units.literal: Chang was on good terms with Xu Jingcheng; when questioned at court their statements were all forthright; the Emperor grasped Jingcheng's hand and wept.

units.zh: 昶連上二疏，力言奸民不可縱，使臣不宜殺，皆不報。
units.en: Chang sent two memorials in succession urging that rioters not be indulged and envoys not be killed; neither was answered.
units.literal: Chang submitted two memorials in succession, strongly stating that wicked commoners must not be indulged and envoys must not be killed; none received response.

units.zh: 復與景澄合上第三疏，嚴劾釀亂大臣，未及奏，已被禍，疏稿為世稱誦。
units.en: He and Jingcheng drafted a third memorial impeaching the ministers who brewed the crisis; before it reached the throne he was dead, yet the draft became famous.
units.literal: He again joined Jingcheng in submitting a third memorial, sternly impeaching the ministers who brewed the disorder; before it could be presented he had already met disaster; the draft was praised by the world.

units.zh: 追諡忠節，江南人祠之蕪湖。
units.en: Posthumously titled Zhongjie, Loyal and Upright, he was enshrined at Wuhu by Jiangnan gentry.
units.literal: He was posthumously given the title Zhongjie; people of Jiangnan enshrined him at Wuhu.

units.zh: 昶嘗慨士鮮實學，輯農桑、兵、醫、輿地、治術、掌故諸書，為漸西村叢刻。
units.en: Lamenting scholars' lack of practical learning, he compiled works on farming, sericulture, war, medicine, geography, statecraft, and precedent as the Jianxi Village Collectanea.
units.literal: Chang once lamented that scholars lacked practical learning and compiled books on agriculture, sericulture, military affairs, medicine, geography, statecraft, and institutional precedent into the Jianxi Village Collectanea.

units.zh: 立山，字豫甫，土默特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。
units.en: Li Shan, courtesy name Yufu, of the Tumet clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
units.literal: Li Shan, courtesy name Yufu, of the Tumet clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 光緒五年，以員外郎出監蘇州織造，歷四任迺得代。
units.en: In Guangxu 5 he went out as assistant director to supervise Suzhou weaving and held the post four terms before relief.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, as an assistant department director, he went out to supervise Suzhou weaving and served four terms before he could be replaced.

units.zh: 論修南苑工，賜二品服。
units.en: For supervising Southern Park repairs he was granted second-rank court dress.
units.literal: For discussing repairs to the Southern Park works he was granted second-rank court dress.

units.zh: 累遷奉宸苑卿、總管內務府大臣、正白旗漢軍副都統、戶部侍郎。
units.en: He rose through director of imperial parks, household superintendent, vice commander of the Plain White Chinese Banner, to vice minister of Revenue.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Director of the Imperial Parks, Superintendent of the Imperial Household, Vice Commander of the Plain White Banner Chinese Brigade, and Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 二十年，加太子少保。
units.en: In year 20 he received the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 盜竊寧壽宮物，坐失察，鐫職留任。
units.en: After theft from Ningshou Palace he was demoted for lax supervision but kept in office.
units.literal: When objects were stolen from the Ningshou Palace he was punished for failure of supervision, his rank was cut, yet he retained his post.

units.zh: 二十六年，擢戶部尚書。
units.en: In year 26 he was made Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 立山久典內廷，同列嫉其寵眷。
units.en: Long in charge of the inner court, he was envied by colleagues for imperial favor.
units.literal: Li Shan had long managed the inner court; colleagues envied his favor.

units.zh: 會拳禍起，聯軍至天津，廷臣集議御前。
units.en: When the Boxer crisis broke and allies reached Tianjin, ministers met in audience before the throne.
units.literal: When the Boxer calamity arose and the allied armies reached Tianjin, court ministers assembled for deliberation before the throne.

units.zh: 載漪盛推拳民可用，立山適在側，太后謂：「汝言如何？」
units.en: Zaiyi loudly insisted the Boxers could be used; Li Shan stood nearby when the Empress Dowager asked, "What do you say?"
units.literal: Zaiyi strongly praised the Boxers as usable; Li Shan happened to be at the side; the Empress Dowager said: "What is your view?"

units.zh: 立山曰：「拳民雖無他，然其術多不驗．」載漪怒曰：「用其心耳，奚問術？
units.en: Li Shan replied, "The Boxers may mean well, but their magic seldom works." Zaiyi snapped, "We need their loyalty—why quibble over tricks?
units.literal: Li Shan said: "Though the Boxers have no other fault, their arts mostly do not work." Zaiyi angrily said: "Use their hearts—that is all; why ask about arts?

units.zh: 立山必與外人通，請以立山退外兵！」
units.en: Li Shan must be colluding with foreigners—send him to make the foreign troops withdraw!"
units.literal: Li Shan must be in league with foreigners; I request that Li Shan be sent to drive off the foreign armies!"

units.zh: 立山曰：「首言戰者載漪也！
units.en: Li Shan answered, "Zaiyi was the first to urge war!
units.literal: Li Shan said: "The first to speak for war was Zaiyi!

units.zh: 臣主和，又不諳外事，不足任。」
units.en: I favor peace and know nothing of foreign affairs; I am not fit for the task."
units.literal: Your servant favors peace and is moreover unskilled in foreign affairs—not fit for the task."

units.zh: 載漪益仇之，因其宅讫教堂，迺中以蜚語，謂藏匿外人，竟論死。
units.en: Zaiyi hated him more than ever; because his house had been a church, rumor said he hid foreigners, and he was condemned to death.
units.literal: Zaiyi hated him all the more; because his residence had once been a church, he was then struck by slanderous talk that he harbored foreigners, and he was finally sentenced to death.

units.zh: 宣統元年，追諡忠貞。
units.en: In Xuantong 1 he received the posthumous title Zhongzhen, Loyal and Steadfast.
units.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he was posthumously given the title Zhongzhen.

units.zh: 聯元，字仙蘅，崔佳氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。
units.en: Lian Yuan, courtesy name Xianheng, of the Cuijia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
units.literal: Lian Yuan, courtesy name Xianheng, of the Cuijia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

units.zh: 同治七年進士，選庶吉士，授檢討，累遷侍講。
units.en: In Tongzhi 7 he became a metropolitan graduate and Hanlin bachelor, was made reviser, and rose to supervising reader.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed reviser, and was promoted in succession to supervising reader.

units.zh: 大考，左遷中允，再陟侍講。
units.en: After a poor grand examination he was demoted to junior expositor, then promoted again to supervising reader.
units.literal: In the grand examination he was demoted to junior expositor and again rose to supervising reader.

units.zh: 以京察，出知安徽太平府，調安慶。
units.en: On a capital inspection he became prefect of Taiping in Anhui, then was moved to Anqing.
units.literal: Through the capital inspection he went out as prefect of Taiping in Anhui and was transferred to Anqing.

units.zh: 兩薦卓異，署滁和道，遷廣東惠潮嘉道。
units.en: Twice rated outstanding, he served as acting intendant on the Chuzhou-He circuit and then as intendant of Huizhou, Chaozhou, and Jiazhou in Guangdong.
units.literal: Twice recommended as outstanding, he acted as intendant of Chuzhou and He prefectures and was transferred to intendant of Huizhou, Chaozhou, and Jiazhou in Guangdong.

units.zh: 汕頭者，通商要衢也，奸人倚英領事為民暴，聯元裁以法，良善獲安。
units.en: At Shantou, a vital treaty port, ruffians sheltered behind the British consul to prey on the people until Lian Yuan punished them by law and the law-abiding were safe.
units.literal: Shantou was a key port for foreign trade; wicked men relied on the British consul to tyrannize the people; Lian Yuan judged them by law and the good obtained peace.

units.zh: 二十四年，擢安徽按察使，入覲，改三品京堂，在總理衙門行走。
units.en: In year 24 he became Anhui judicial commissioner; after audience he was made a third-rank capital official at the Zongli Yamen.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to Anhui judicial commissioner; on entering audience he was made a third-rank capital official serving at the Zongli Yamen.

units.zh: 又明年，補內閣學士。
units.en: The following year he was appointed Hanlin bachelor.
units.literal: The next year he was appointed Hanlin bachelor.

units.zh: 拳民仇西教，載漪、剛毅助之，勢益橫，日夜圍攻使館，不能下。
units.en: Boxers hated Christianity; backed by Zaiyi and Gang Yi they grew bolder, besieging the legations day and night without success.
units.literal: The Boxers hated Western religion; Zaiyi and Gang Yi supported them; their power grew all the more overbearing; day and night they besieged the legations but could not take them.

units.zh: 大臣負清望者徐桐、崇綺，皆謂：「民氣可用。」
units.en: Respected ministers Xu Tong and Chongqi both declared, "The people's spirit can be harnessed."
units.literal: Ministers of high repute, Xu Tong and Chongqi, all said: "Popular spirit can be used."

units.zh: 聯元與崇綺爭論帝前，謂：「民氣可用，匪氣不可用。」
units.en: Before the emperor Lian Yuan argued with Chongqi: "Popular spirit may be used, but bandit spirit must not."
units.literal: Lian Yuan debated with Chongqi before the Emperor, saying: "Popular spirit can be used; bandit spirit cannot be used."

units.zh: 聯軍既陷大沽，載漪等猶壹意主戰。
units.en: Even after the allies captured Dagu, Zaiyi and his party still insisted on war.
units.literal: After the allied armies had taken Dagu, Zaiyi and others still single-mindedly favored war.

units.zh: 聯元謂：「甲午之役，一日本且不能勝，況八強國乎？
units.en: Lian Yuan said, "In the Sino-Japanese War we could not beat Japan alone—what chance against eight great powers?
units.literal: Lian Yuan said: "In the war of Jiawu, China could not even defeat Japan alone—how much less eight great powers?

units.zh: 儻戰而敗，如宗廟何？」
units.en: If we fight and lose, what becomes of the ancestral shrines?"
units.literal: If we fight and are defeated, what of the ancestral temples?"

units.zh: 載漪斥其言不祥，七月十七日，斬西市。
units.en: Zaiyi called his words unlucky; on the seventeenth of the seventh month he was beheaded at the West Market.
units.literal: Zaiyi denounced his words as ill-omened; on the seventeenth day of the seventh month he was beheaded at the West Market.

units.zh: 昭雪後，予諡文直。
units.en: After rehabilitation he received the posthumous title Wenzhi, Cultured and Upright.
units.literal: After rehabilitation he was given the posthumous title Wenzhi.

units.zh: 順天府奏請立山、聯元合祠宣武門外，而聯元祖居寶坻，更於其地建專祠焉。
units.en: Shuntian requested a joint shrine to Li Shan and Lian Yuan outside Xuanwu Gate; because Lian Yuan's family came from Baodi, a separate shrine was built there as well.
units.literal: Shuntian prefecture memorialized requesting a joint shrine for Li Shan and Lian Yuan outside Xuanwu Gate; because Lian Yuan's ancestral home was in Baodi, a separate shrine was also built there.

units.zh: 論曰：清代優禮廷臣，罕有誅罰。
units.en: The historian remarks: The Qing usually honored court ministers and seldom put them to death.
units.literal: The commentator says: The Qing dynasty treated court ministers with favor and rarely punished them.

units.zh: 拳禍既起，忠諫大臣駢首就戮，豈獨非帝意哉？
units.en: When the Boxer crisis came, loyal ministers who spoke out were executed in batches—surely this was not the emperor's wish alone?
units.literal: Once the Boxer calamity arose, loyal remonstrating ministers were slaughtered in rows—was this solely contrary to the Emperor's intent?

units.zh: 觀用儀諸人所論事勢利害，昭昭如此，迺終不能回當軸之聽，何其昧焉？
units.en: The case Yongyi and his fellows made for war or peace was plain enough, yet those in power would not listen—how blind were they?
units.literal: Considering the advantages and harms of the situation as Yongyi and the others discussed them, so clear as this, yet in the end they could not turn the ears of those in power—how blind?

units.zh: 世傳大節，並號「五忠」，不數日而遂昭雪，允哉！
units.en: Posterity honors their integrity as the "Five Loyal Ones"; within days they were cleared—rightly so!
units.literal: The world transmits their great integrity; together they were called the "Five Loyal Ones"; within a few days they were rehabilitated—fitting indeed!

units.zh: 俱下協辦大學士剛毅查復。
units.en: All were referred to Associate Grand Secretary Gangyi for investigation.
units.literal: All were referred to Associate Grand Secretary Gangyi for investigation and reply.

units.zh: 剛毅時以事銜命赴蘇，尋疏陳：「電局自恰線成後，所虧至鉅，俟有贏餘，歲輸南北洋學款十二萬四千兩。」
units.en: Gangyi was then on assignment in Suzhou. He soon reported: "Since the Kyakhta line was completed, the telegraph bureau's losses have been enormous. When surpluses arise, it remits 124,000 taels annually for Northern and Southern Seas educational funds."
units.literal: Gangyi was then on assignment in Suzhou on imperial orders. He soon memorialized: "Since the Kyakhta line was completed, the telegraph bureau's losses have been enormous. When there are surpluses, it remits one hundred twenty-four thousand taels annually for Northern and Southern Seas educational funds."

units.zh: 二十五年，大學士徐桐言電報局獲利不貲，並無裨益公家之實。
units.en: In 1899, Grand Secretary Xu Tong argued that the telegraph bureau reaped enormous profits while bringing no real benefit to the state.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Grand Secretary Xu Tong stated that the telegraph bureau reaped immeasurable profit yet brought no real benefit to the state.

units.zh: 程祖誥五月癸巳休。七月辛未曾紀澤左副都御史。未任。徐用儀署。十二月癸未改署。張家驤署左副都御史。
units.en: On the guisi day of the fifth month, Cheng Zugao retired. On the xinwei day of the seventh month, Zeng Jize: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. He did not assume the post. Xu Yongyi served in an acting capacity. On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, the acting appointment was changed. Zhang Jiaxiang served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the guisi day of the fifth month, Cheng Zugao retired. On the xinwei day of the seventh month, Zeng Jize: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. He did not assume the post. Xu Yongyi served in an acting capacity. On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, the acting appointment was changed. Zhang Jiaxiang served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 光緒七年辛巳
units.en: The seventh year of the Guangxu reign (xinsi).
units.literal: Guangxu year 7, xinsi.

units.zh: 倭仁正月己亥遷。文祥左都御史。閏八月丙申遷。載齡左都御史。
units.en: On the jihai day of the first month, Woren was transferred. Wenxiang: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, was transferred. Zailing: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the jihai day of the first month, Woren was transferred. Wenxiang: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, was transferred. Zailing: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 同治元年壬戌
units.en: First year of the Tongzhi reign (renxu)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 1, renxu

units.zh: 於是慶親王奕劻等以天澤堂廉之辨，不能每事曲從。
units.en: Thereupon Prince Qing and others, mindful of the distinction between imperial majesty and the dignity of the hall, could not accede to every demand.
units.literal: Thereupon Prince Qing and others, mindful of the distinction between imperial majesty and the dignity of the hall, could not accede to every demand.

units.zh: 慶親王等侍左右，外部長官率亨利等自中門入，北鄉一鞠躬，行數武又一鞠躬，至龍柱前又一鞠躬。
units.en: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.
units.literal: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.

units.zh: 二十七年，聯軍平拳匪，各國挾求更改禮節。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.

units.zh: 各國親王覲見儀，始光緒二十四年。
units.en: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.
units.literal: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.

units.zh: 遂與各使磋商，歷時數月，始將乘坐黃轎、太和殿覲見暨宮殿階前降輿三事酌議改易，而爭議始息。
units.en: They then negotiated with the various envoys; after several months, agreement was finally reached to modify the three points concerning yellow sedans, audiences in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and dismounting before the palace steps—and only then did the disputes cease.
units.literal: They then negotiated with the various envoys; after several months, agreement was finally reached to modify the three points concerning yellow sedans, audiences in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and dismounting before the palace steps—and only then did the disputes cease.

units.zh: 然後奉國書進，慶親王降左階接受，陳玉案，亨利等又一鞠躬，帝頷首答之，操國語慰勞。
units.en: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.
units.literal: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.

units.zh: 慶親王跪案左聆玉音，降階，操漢語傳宣。
units.en: Prince Qing knelt at the left of the table to listen to the imperial words, then descended the steps and relayed the message in Chinese.
units.literal: Prince Qing knelt at the left of the table to listen to the jade voice, then descended the steps and relayed the message in Chinese.

units.zh: 徐桐五月戊辰遷。翁同龢左都御史。
units.en: On the wuchen day of the fifth month, Xu Tong was transferred. Weng Tonghe: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wuchen day of the fifth month, Xu Tong was transferred. Weng Tonghe: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 翁同龢正月庚午遷。潘祖蔭左都御史。三月乙卯遷。童華左都御史。
units.en: On the gengwu day of the first month, Weng Tonghe was transferred. Pan Zuyin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the third month, was transferred. Tong Hua: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the gengwu day of the first month, Weng Tonghe was transferred. Pan Zuyin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the third month, was transferred. Tong Hua: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 光緒四年戊寅
units.en: The fourth year of the Guangxu reign (wuyin).
units.literal: Guangxu year 4, wuyin.

units.zh: 光緒五年己卯
units.en: The fifth year of the Guangxu reign (jimao).
units.literal: Guangxu year 5, jimao.

units.zh: 時太后議廢帝，立端王載漪子溥俊為穆宗嗣，患外人為梗，用榮祿言，改稱「大阿哥」。
units.en: The empress dowager then considered deposing the emperor and naming Prince Duan's son Pujun as heir to Muzong's line; fearing foreign interference, she followed Rong Lu's counsel and styled the boy "Great Elder Brother" instead.
units.literal: At that time the empress dowager discussed deposing the emperor and establishing Prince Duan's son Pujun as Muzong's heir; fearing foreign obstruction, on Rong Lu's advice the title was changed to "Great Elder Brother."

units.zh: 二十六年，拳匪亂作，載漪等稱其術，太后信之，欲倚以排外人。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer uprising broke out; Prince Duan and others extolled their magic, the empress dowager trusted them, and hoped to use them to expel foreigners.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer bandits rose in disorder; Zaiyi and others praised their arts; the empress dowager believed them and wished to rely on them to drive out foreigners.

units.zh: 許景澄繼管學，坐論義和團被誅。
units.en: Xu Jingcheng succeeded him as superintendent of studies and was executed for criticizing the Boxers.
units.literal: Xu Jingcheng succeeded as superintendent of studies and was executed for speaking against the Boxers.

units.zh: 楊頤五月壬戌遷。楊儒左副都御史。未任。馮文蔚署左副都御史。十二月卒。壬戌陸寶忠署。
units.en: On the renxu day of the fifth month, Yang Yi was transferred. Yang Ru: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief; he did not assume the office. Feng Wenwei served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, Feng Wenwei died. On the renxu day, Lu Baozhong served in an acting capacity.
units.literal: On the renxu day of the fifth month, Yang Yi was transferred. Yang Ru: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief; he did not assume the office. Feng Wenwei served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, Feng Wenwei died. On the renxu day, Lu Baozhong served in an acting capacity.

units.zh: 楊儒
units.en: Yang Ru.
units.literal: Yang Ru.

units.zh: 楊儒遷。五月戊午曾廣漢左副都御史。六月庚午革。癸酉曾廣鑾左副都御史。
units.en: Yang Ru was transferred. On the wuwu day of the fifth month, Zeng Guanghan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the gengwu day of the sixth month, was dismissed. On the guiyou day, Zeng Guangluan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Yang Ru was transferred. On the wuwu day of the fifth month, Zeng Guanghan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the gengwu day of the sixth month, was dismissed. On the guiyou day, Zeng Guangluan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 光緒二十二年丙申
units.en: The twenty-second year of the Guangxu reign, bingshen cycle year.
units.literal: Guangxu year 22, bingshen.

units.zh: 光緒二十三年丁酉
units.en: The twenty-third year of the Guangxu reign, dingyou cycle year.
units.literal: Guangxu year 23, dingyou.

units.zh: 光緒二十四年戊戌
units.en: The twenty-fourth year of the Guangxu reign, wuxu cycle year.
units.literal: Guangxu year 24, wuxu.

units.zh: 子崇綺，自有傳。
units.en: His son Chongqi has his own biography.
units.literal: His son Chongqi has a separate biography.

units.zh: 光緒元年，卒。
units.en: He died in the first year of Guangxu (1875).
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died.

units.zh: 袁昶、許景澄之死，舉國稱冤，而桐則曰：「是死且有餘辜！」
units.en: When Yuan Chang and Xu Jingcheng were executed, the nation called it a miscarriage of justice; Xu Tong said: "They deserved worse than death!"
units.literal: At the deaths of Yuan Chang and Xu Jingcheng the whole country called it injustice, but Xu Tong said: "Even in death they still had guilt to spare!"

units.zh: 孫毓汶，字萊山，山東濟寧州人，尚書瑞珍子。
units.en: Sun Yuwen, courtesy name Laishan, was from Jining Prefecture in Shandong, son of Minister Sun Ruizhen.
units.literal: Sun Yuwen, styled Laishan, was a native of Jining Prefecture in Shandong, son of Minister Ruizhen.

units.zh: 時日韓起釁，同龢與李鴻藻主戰，孫毓汶、徐用儀主和。
units.en: When war broke out between Japan and Korea, Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored fighting while Sun Yuwen and Xu Yongyi favored peace.
units.literal: At that time hostilities arose between Japan and Korea; Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored war, while Sun Yuwen and Xu Yongyi favored peace.

units.zh: 毓汶以前敵屢敗對，上責以賞罰不嚴，故至於此。
units.en: Yuwen cited repeated defeats in reply; the emperor blamed lax discipline in rewards and punishments for having brought matters to this pass.
units.literal: Yuwen replied citing repeated defeats at the front; the emperor blamed lax rewards and punishments for having brought matters to this pass.

units.zh: 二十五年，卒，予諡文恪。
units.en: In 1899 he died and was given the posthumous title Wenkai.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenkai.

units.zh: 咸豐六年，以一甲二名進士授編修。
units.en: In 1856 he took second place in the jinshi examination and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination as second graduate of the first class and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 適奉硃諭盡罷軍機王大臣，毓汶還，遂命入直軍機，兼總理各國事務大臣。
units.en: Just then a vermilion edict dismissed all the princely Grand Councilors; when Yuwen returned he was appointed to the Grand Council and concurrently made minister for foreign affairs.
units.literal: Just then a vermilion edict dismissed all the princely Grand Councilors; when Yuwen returned, he was ordered to attend on the Grand Council and concurrently serve as minister for foreign affairs.

units.zh: 十年，以在籍辦團抗捐被劾，革職遣戍。
units.en: In 1860, for organizing local militia at home and resisting tax levies, he was impeached, dismissed, and banished.
units.literal: In the tenth year, for organizing local militia at home and resisting levies, he was impeached, dismissed from office, and banished.

units.zh: 二十年，中日媾和，李鴻章遣人齎約至。
units.en: In 1894 China and Japan made peace; Li Hongzhang sent an envoy bearing the treaty.
units.literal: In the twentieth year China and Japan made peace; Li Hongzhang sent someone bearing the treaty.

units.zh: 毓汶素與鴻章相結納，力言戰不可恃，亟請署，上為流涕書之，和約遂成。
units.en: Yuwen had long been allied with Li Hongzhang; he argued that war was hopeless and urgently pressed for signature; the emperor wept as he gave his approval, and the peace treaty was concluded.
units.literal: Yuwen had long been allied with Hongzhang; he strongly argued that war could not be relied upon and urgently asked to sign; the emperor wept as he wrote his approval, and the peace treaty was concluded.

units.zh: 毓汶權奇饒智略，直軍機逾十年。
units.en: Yuwen was resourceful and shrewd; he served on the Grand Council for more than a decade.
units.literal: Yuwen was resourceful and possessed abundant stratagems; he attended on the Grand Council for more than ten years.

units.zh: 同列或不得預聞，故其權特重雲。
units.en: His colleagues sometimes learned of matters only afterward; his authority was therefore especially great, it is said.
units.literal: His colleagues sometimes could not learn of matters beforehand; therefore his authority was especially weighty, it is said.

units.zh: 毓汶奔走其間，勤勞亦著，大體彌縫，賴以無事。
units.en: Yuwen shuttled among them with notable diligence; by smoothing matters over in the main, the court relied on him to keep affairs running.
units.literal: Yuwen hurried back and forth among them; his diligence was also notable, and by smoothing over matters in the main, the court relied on him to keep things untroubled.

units.zh: 八年，丁父憂。
units.en: In 1858 he withdrew to mourn his father.
units.literal: In the eighth year he entered mourning for his father.

units.zh: 光緒元年，丁母憂。
units.en: In 1875 he withdrew to mourn his mother.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he entered mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 妻翁內閣學士聯元既以論拳匪誅，家屬匿其宅，眾以壽富重新學，亦指為袒外，恚甚，或勸之他往，曰：「吾宗親也，寧有去理耶？」
units.en: His father-in-law, Grand Secretariat academician Lian Yuan, had already been executed for criticizing the Boxers; Lian's family took refuge in Shou Fu's house. Because Shou Fu championed Western learning, the crowd accused him of siding with foreigners and grew furious. When some urged him to flee, he said: 'I am of the imperial clan—how could I leave?'
units.literal: His father-in-law, Grand Secretariat academician Lian Yuan, had already been executed for discussing the Boxer bandits; his family hid in his residence; the crowd, because Shou Fu advocated new learning, also accused him of favoring foreigners and were deeply enraged; some urged him to go elsewhere; he said: 'I am of the imperial clan—how could there be reason to leave?'
